instruction.text: Replace the underlined part of the sentence with the correct possessive pronoun.

atoms.a: Is this car <u>George and Oscar’s car</u>?
The bracelet I found was <u>Sophia’s bracelet</u>.
atoms.finishSound: The bracelet I found was hers.

instruction.text: Replace the underlined part of the text with the correct possessive pronoun.

atoms.a: That’s <u>our toy</u>. You can play with it.
atoms.b: That’s ((ours)). You can play with it.
atoms.finishSound: That’s ours. You can play with it.

atoms.a: My house is the same colour as <u>Muneera and Jamal’s house</u>. Have you seen <u>my house</u>?
atoms.b: My house is the same colour as ((theirs)). Have you seen ((mine))?
atoms.finishSound: My house is the same colour as theirs. Have you seen mine?

atoms.a: I took <u>your pencil case</u> home by mistake. Do you have <u>my pencil case</u>?
atoms.b: I took ((yours)) home by mistake. Do you have ((mine))?
atoms.finishSound: I took yours home by mistake. Do you have mine?
